meta.fiscal_year_note: Fiscal years run October to September.

definitions.headcount: Employees active on a date (hired on or before it, not terminated before it).
definitions.turnover_rate: Terminations in the fiscal year divided by average month-end headcount.
definitions.voluntary_turnover_rate: Voluntary terminations divided by average month-end headcount.
definitions.early_turnover_share: Share of terminations with less than one year of tenure.
definitions.days_to_fill: Days from requisition open date to offer acceptance, for filled requisitions.
definitions.offer_acceptance_rate: Accepted offers divided by offers extended on requisitions closed in the year.
definitions.vacancy_rate: Open requisitions divided by headcount plus open requisitions at fiscal year end.
definitions.overtime_rate: Overtime hours divided by regular hours (nonexempt employees).
definitions.premium_pay_share: Overtime, shift differential and other pay as a share of gross pay.
definitions.sla_met_rate: Closed HR cases resolved within their priority's SLA target.
definitions.first_contact_resolution: Tier 1 cases resolved on first contact.
definitions.compa_ratio: Current pay divided by the midpoint of the job's pay range.

enterprise.headline: 5,035 people on the payroll, 1,011 hired and 992 gone in FY24.
enterprise.body: Headcount for the system grew by 24 over the year. Replacing roughly one in five people every year is the defining fact of this workforce: turnover was 19.8%, and gross payroll reached $391.8 million.

retention.headline: Turnover ran at 19.8%.
retention.body: Voluntary turnover was 15.8%. 35.4% of everyone who left had been here less than a year, so the first twelve months are where retention is won or lost. The most common reason for leaving was “better pay elsewhere.” Nursing turnover peaked at an annualized 21.6% in June 2024.

talent.headline: It took 37.5 days on average to fill a role.
talent.body: Recruiters filled 1,009 requisitions and closed the year with 128 still open, a 2.5% vacancy rate. 78.9% of offers were accepted.

payroll.headline: Overtime was 5.25% of regular hours, costing $21.0 million.
payroll.body: Every open position becomes someone else's extra shift. Across 25 pay periods and 126,378 checks, premium pay (overtime, shift differentials and bonuses) made up 7.27% of gross pay. Payroll issued 504 off-cycle corrections, 3.99 per thousand checks.

services.headline: The HR service center handled 8,082 cases and met SLA on 89.2%.
services.body: That is 161.0 cases for every 100 employees. The median case was resolved in 20.5 hours, 50.2% of tier 1 cases were resolved on first contact, and satisfaction averaged 3.95 out of 5. Every case was triaged by hand, and the median time to route a case was 5.45 hours.

compensation.headline: The average employee is paid at 0.966 of their range midpoint.
compensation.body: 72.2% of employees are paid below their range midpoint. Within the same job, women earn 99.8 cents for every dollar men earn.
